about_the_game:
The WWE 2K25 SuperCharger puts the biggest Legends in the WWE Universe in your hands. Unlock all WWE Legends available at launch, including Rob Van Dam, Stacy Keibler, and Eddie Guerrero. Plus, you’ll also unlock throwback arenas such as WCW Fall Brawl WarGames and SummerSlam ‘88!

The SuperCharger is part of the Season Pass, which is included as part of the WWE 2K25 Deadman Edition. The Season Pass is part of the Ringside Pass, which comes included with WWE 2K25 The Bloodline Edition.
